description: Ministry of Transport Highways and Urban Development - The Motor traffic (Driving Licence Levy ) Regulations No 03 of 2022
categorisation: The gazette content is a notification of regulations made by the Minister under the Motor Traffic Act. It amends specific fee schedules for driving licenses. This falls squarely under the definition of "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5)" as it involves subsidiary legislation (regulations) that modify existing legal frameworks and compliance requirements. While a minister's name and title are present, the core content is the regulatory amendment itself, not a government personnel change or a detailed assignment of that minister's portfolio responsibilities. Therefore, the specialized legal/regulatory classification takes precedence over the government personnel classification.
